replication.target_description: Study 1 is identified, but generic Anchoring does not distinguish experimenter-provided or self-generated anchoring effects from the NFC association; reported-success correspondence unresolved.

reported_success.quote:
Anchoring effects were significant for all three experimenter-provided anchoring items ... which was the case for two
of the eight items. ... there were no correlations between need for cogni-
tion and susceptibility to anchoring.

notes: Identity independently checked: supplied canonical text identifies the matching title, all twelve named authors, DOI 10.18718/81781.38, JCRE Volume 3 (2024-8), and a published primary replication report with methods, results, discussion and references through page 42. Text is a PDF-derived primary article, not an abstract or preregistration. No PDF was supplied. Only reported_success is assigned; all side statistic fields are unassigned placeholders. Target ambiguous: the description Anchoring and page-15 locator (Study 2 procedure, not Study 1) do not identify the outcome whose replication verdict is requested. Candidates: significant experimenter-provided anchoring for all three tested items (p. 11); self-generated anchoring in two of eight items (p. 11); failed NFC/anchoring association (p. 11). The p. 12 discussion additionally calls experimenter-provided effects relatively small and says only two out of four items displayed anchoring effects, creating a source-internal discrepancy with p. 11. No candidate was selected by row order or numeric matching. A global successful, failed or mixed verdict would conflate distinct targets.
